simulated.provider: Loopback GitHub REST fixture (axum in crates/crewroom-runtime/tests/github_publication.rs); not github.com.
checks: github_pull_requests_publish_continue_and_report_readiness_at_a_named_revision: verify repository by numeric id; empty branch search; create returns the normalized OPEN PR with head/base/repository github:42; marker search finds the same PR; description update after a new push keeps PR #5 and reads back the new head; no second PR

Hosted evidence: latest commit status per context; a check re-run replaces the earlier run; check runs naming this PR bind destination_commit to the base; provider-neutral assess() reports ready for that exact head/base and names 'The PR head, base or branch no longer matches local evidence.' for an older revision
A check run that does not name the PR leaves the base unbound and readiness blocked; a failed required check latches reviewInvalidated
closed+merged_at maps to MERGED with the merge commit; closed without merge maps to DECLINED; an open PR's test-merge commit is not reported
github_feedback_reads_every_page_of_conversation_and_review_comments: 120 conversation comments over two pages plus inline review comments with path/line/outdated/parent

github_refusals_are_reported_with_remedies_and_never_skipped: 401 names Settings → Integrations and never echoes the token; 403 names Pull requests and Contents Read and write; 404 names repository access; 401/403/404 on create keep the intent pending (request_sent false); rate limit maps to 429; 422 stays sent/blocking; a read-only account is refused before any write
